item.title: Report Offers Insights on Manufacturing, Distribution
item.description: The 2026 "State of the Channel" report is based on HARDI’s proprietary data, industry surveys, and expert analysis.

item.title: HARDI, PHCC Seek SCOTUS Review of Efficiency Standard
item.description: Heating, Air-conditioning & Refrigeration Distributors International, the Plumbing-Heating-Cooling Contractors–National Association, and the Natural Gas Association of Georgia argue that the efficiency standards would undermine statutory protections of consumer choice and access to affordable, reliable heating options.

item.title: ASHRAE and UNEP Approve Two-Year Work Plan Focused on Life Cycle Refrigerant Management
item.description: As the refrigerating and air-conditioning (RAC) industry transitions to alternative refrigerants, comprehensive management across the full refrigerant life cycle, from production and installation to recovery, reuse and disposal, has become increasingly critical.

item.title: Smarter Rooftops: How Connected RTUs Are Changing HVAC
item.description: Once seen as a simple workhorse, rooftop units are becoming intelligent building assets — changing how contractors install, commission, and service commercial HVAC systems.

item.title: Q-PAC Fan Achieves Seismic Certification for Critical Facilities
item.description: Q-PAC’s Multimotor Plenum Fan is now HCAI OSP-0875 certified, delivering a modular, code-compliant HVAC fan option engineered to stay operational during earthquakes.

item.title: Infinitum Unveils Grid-Friendly EC Fan Systems at AHR Expo, Targeting Data Centers
item.description: New integrated EC Fan Systems promise higher efficiency, fewer motors, and grid-friendly power for data centers and mission-critical environments.

item.title: Oregon Requiring Heat Pumps on New Homes
item.description: New homes in Oregon will be built using heat pumps instead of ducted a/c, a move that might be replicated in other states.

item.title: ClimateMaster Launches Tranquility SL Low-Profile Series, Water-Source Heat Pumps
item.description: For environments that demand quiet comfort, the Tranquility SL includes an UltraQuiet sound-attenuation package, double isolation compressor mounting and an integrated sound attenuator box.

item.title: Thermaduct Unveils Thermatuff Phenolic Panels at AHR Expo
item.description: Thermaduct’s Thermatuff phenolic panels simplify HVAC duct insulation and installation by enabling use in pre-insulated, lined, and glueless sheet metal systems for commercial applications.

item.title: A Tale of Two HVAC Markets: Residential Slumps, Commercial Surges in Q4
item.description: Q4 shows different directions for residential and commercial HVAC.
